title: Apartment Fractional Jump Decomposition
body_html:
Apartment Fractional Jump Decomposition

Appendix 1 decomposes \(V\) by fractional jump classes. If \(\nu_D=1\), then \[ V^{[r]}=\bigoplus_{a_i=r\;(\operatorname{mod}\mathbb Z)} e_iK. \] If \(\nu_D=1/2\), then \[ V^{[r]}= \bigoplus_{a_i=r} e_iK \oplus \bigoplus_{a_i+1/2=r} e_i\pi_DK. \] The lattice \(V^r=V^{[r]}\cap L_r\) satisfies \[ V^r/V^rp_K\simeq L_r/L_{r+}. \] The decomposition pairs \(V^{[r]}\) with \(V^{[-r]}\), with special self-dual factors at \(r=0\) and \(r=\nu_D/2\).
